g.title: ERD
g.text: PK = primary key FK = foreign key UQ = unique * = NOT NULL (including PK) ? = nullable
Arrows: FK field -> referenced PK field. Each child has 1 parent (*) or 0..1 parent (?). Each parent has 0..N children.
Indexes, types and defaults are copied from DBML. Target design only; not a live database migration.
